title: making ozentime antivirus
description: Ozentime Antivirus is a newly released free antivirus software offering two editions: a lightweight 1.5 Pro version and a 2.0 flagship version with an AI engine and VPN. Both editions perform user-mode heuristic scanning without kernel or rootkit defense. The VPN included in version 2.0 is not encrypted. The software supports Windows 7 through 11 and aims to be lightweight and easy to use. There is no indication of vulnerabilities or security threats associated with this product in the provided information.
